field_errors.evidence: The ionic conductivity of ~6 x 10 cm−1 at 300 K (Conclusions, same sentence as the conductivity value; the trailing '−3' in the garbled text gives 6x10^-3)

verdicts.explanation: Material (50SISOMO), the 6x10^-3 Ω−1 cm−1 value, experimental origin, impedance method, milling synthesis and the 0.20 eV activation energy all match the paper. The paper does state 300 K for this conductivity in the Conclusions, so the null Celsius temperature is an omission rather than a correct null (300 K = 27 °C).
